# Isaiah Chapter 40 -- The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**40:1** Comfort [nachamu], comfort [nachamu] my-people [ammi], says [yomar] your-God [Eloheikhem].

**40:2** Speak [dabberu] to-the-heart [al lev] of-Jerusalem [Yerushalayim] and-call [ve-qir'u] to-her [eleha]: that her-warfare [tzeva'ah] is-ended [male'ah], that her-iniquity [avonah] is-pardoned [nirtzah], that she-has-received [ki laqchah] from-the-hand [mi-yad] of-the-LORD [YHVH] double [kiflayim] for-all [be-khol] her-sins [chatto'teha].

**40:3** A-voice [qol] cries [qore]: "In-the-wilderness [ba-midbar] prepare [pannu] the-way [derekh] of-the-LORD [YHVH]; make-straight [yashsheru] in-the-desert [ba-aravah] a-highway [mesillah] for-our-God [le-Eloheinu]."

**40:4** Every valley [kol gei] shall-be-lifted [yinnase], and-every [ve-khol] mountain [har] and-hill [ve-giv'ah] shall-be-made-low [yishpalu]; and-the-uneven [ve-hayah he-aqov] shall-become [le-mishor] level, and-the-rough-places [ve-ha-rekhashim] a-plain [le-viq'ah].

**40:5** And-the-glory [kevod] of-the-LORD [YHVH] shall-be-revealed [ve-niglah], and-all [ve-ra'u khol] flesh [basar] together [yachdav] shall-see [it]; for the-mouth [ki pi] of-the-LORD [YHVH] has-spoken [dibber].

**40:6** A-voice [qol] says [omer]: "Cry-out [qera]!" And-I-said [ve-amar]: "What [mah] shall-I-cry [eqra]?" "All [kol] flesh [ha-basar] [is] grass [chatzir], and-all [ve-khol] its-beauty [chasdo] [is] like-the-flower [ke-tzitz] of-the-field [ha-sadeh]."

**40:7** "The-grass [chatzir] withers [yavesh], the-flower [tzitz] fades [navel], when [ki] the-breath [ruach] of-the-LORD [YHVH] blows [nashvah] upon-it [bo]. Surely [akhen] the-people [ha-am] [are] grass [chatzir]."

**40:8** "The-grass [chatzir] withers [yavesh], the-flower [tzitz] fades [navel]; but-the-word [u-devar] of-our-God [Eloheinu] shall-stand [yaqum] forever [le-olam]."

**40:9** Get-up [ali] on a-high [gavoha] mountain [har], O-Zion [Tziyyon], herald-of-good-news [mevaseret]; lift-up [harimi] your-voice [qolekh] with-strength [ba-koach], O-Jerusalem [Yerushalayim], herald-of-good-news [mevaseret]; lift [harimi], do-not-fear [al tira'i]. Say [imri] to-the-cities [le-arei] of-Judah [Yehudah]: "Behold [hinneh] your-God [Eloheikhem]!"

**40:10** Behold [hinneh], the-Lord [Adonai] GOD [YHVH] comes [yavo] with-might [be-chazaq], and-his-arm [u-zero'o] rules [moshelah] for-him [lo]. Behold [hinneh], his-reward [sekharo] [is] with-him [itto], and-his-recompense [u-fe'ullato] [is] before-him [lefanav].

**40:11** Like-a-shepherd [ke-ro'eh] he-tends [yir'eh] his-flock [edro]; in-his-arm [bi-zero'o] he-gathers [yeqabbetz] lambs [tela'im], and-in-his-bosom [u-ve-cheiqo] he-carries [yissa] [them]; nursing-ewes [alot] he-leads-gently [yenahal].

**40:12** Who [mi] has-measured [maddad] the-waters [mayim] in-the-hollow-of-his-hand [be-sha'alo], and-marked-off [ve-shamayim ba-zeret tikken] the-heavens with-a-span, and-enclosed [ve-khal] the-dust [ba-shalish afar] of-the-earth [ha-aretz] in-a-measure, and-weighed [ve-shaqal] the-mountains [harim] in-scales [ba-peles] and-the-hills [u-geva'ot] in-a-balance [be-mozna'im]?

**40:13** Who [mi] has-measured [tikken] the-Spirit [et ruach] of-the-LORD [YHVH], or-what-man [u-mi ish] as-his-counselor [atzato] has-taught-him [yodi'ennu]?

**40:14** With-whom [et mi] did-he-consult [no'atz], and-who-made-him-understand [va-yvinenhu]? And-who-taught-him [va-yelamdehu] the-path [be-orach] of-justice [mishpat]? And-who-taught-him [va-yelamdehu] knowledge [da'at], and-the-way [ve-derekh] of-understanding [tevunot] showed-him [yodi'ennu]?

**40:15** Behold [hen], nations [goyim] [are] like-a-drop [ke-mar] from-a-bucket [mi-deli], and-like-dust [u-khe-shachaq] on-scales [mozna'im] they-are-regarded [nechshavu]; behold [hen], coastlands [iyyim] he-takes-up [yittol] like-fine-dust [ka-daq].

**40:22** He-who-sits [ha-yoshev] above [al] the-circle [chug] of-the-earth [ha-aretz], and-its-inhabitants [ve-yoshveha] [are] like-grasshoppers [ka-chagavim]; he-stretches-out [ha-noteh] the-heavens [shamayim] like-a-curtain [ka-doq] and-spreads-them [va-yimtachem] like-a-tent [ka-ohel] to-dwell-in [la-shavet].

**40:28** Have-you-not-known [ha-lo yadata]? Have-you-not-heard [im lo shama'ta]? The-God [Elohei] of-everlasting [olam] — the-LORD [YHVH], the-Creator [bore] of-the-ends [qetzot] of-the-earth [ha-aretz] — does-not-faint [lo yi'af] and-does-not-grow-weary [ve-lo yiga]; there-is-no-searching [ein cheqer] of-his-understanding [li-tevunato].

**40:29** He-gives [noten] power [koach] to-the-faint [la-ya'ef], and-to-him-who-has-no [u-le-ein] might [onim] he-increases [yarbeh] strength [otzmah].

**40:30** Youths [ne'arim] shall-faint [yi'afu] and-be-weary [ve-yig'u], and-young-men [u-vachurim] shall-utterly-fall [kashol yikkashelu].

**40:31** But-those-who-wait [ve-qovei] for-the-LORD [YHVH] shall-renew [yachalifu] [their] strength [koach]; they-shall-mount-up [ya'alu] with-wings [ever] like-eagles [ka-nesharim]; they-shall-run [yarutzu] and-not-be-weary [ve-lo yig'u]; they-shall-walk [yelekhu] and-not-faint [ve-lo yi'afu].

---

## EMET's Textual Notes

**v.1 — "Comfort, comfort":** The doubled imperative *nachamu nachamu* marks the dramatic shift from First Isaiah (chs. 1–39, judgment) to Second Isaiah (chs. 40–55, comfort). The verb is in the plural imperative — addressed to the heavenly council.

**v.3 — "A voice cries in the wilderness":** The Hebrew syntax is ambiguous: is it "A voice cries: 'In the wilderness prepare...'" or "A voice cries in the wilderness: 'Prepare...'"? The MT accents favor the former; the LXX and NT (Mark 1:3) read the latter.

**v.6-8 — "All flesh is grass":** The contrast between the transience of human life (*chatzir*, grass) and the permanence of God's word (*devar Eloheinu*) is the theological foundation of Second Isaiah's message: empires pass, but God's purpose stands.

**v.31 — "mount up with wings like eagles":** The Hebrew *nesharim* can mean eagles or vultures. The image is of soaring effortlessly on thermals — renewed strength that does not depend on human effort but on waiting for God.

*-- EMET*
